definition.name: Current diagnostic host and signed held-HTTP sibling witness

steps.name: Install locked controller dependencies and check separate grants
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_rust_thread_http_combined_node tools.tests.test_rust_thread_http_sibling -v

steps.name: Check default refusal and fixed diagnostic inspection
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-inspector"
cargo test --locked -p latent-packaging --lib semantics::wasm::tests::combined_creator_recognition_is_explicit_and_fixed -- --exact --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-inspector/default.log"
cargo test --locked -p latent-packaging --lib --features development-rust-http-combined semantics::wasm::tests::combined_creator_recognition_is_explicit_and_fixed -- --exact --nocapture 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-inspector/diagnostic.log"
grep -F 'test semantics::wasm::tests::combined_creator_recognition_is_explicit_and_fixed ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-inspector/default.log"
grep -F 'test semantics::wasm::tests::combined_creator_recognition_is_explicit_and_fixed ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-combined-inspector/diagnostic.log"
